description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for search filter parameters related to termination reason configuration in the HRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and sets default sort fields.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for termination reason configuration search filter parameters in the HRM system. It includes a constant for allowed sort fields and initializes the default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the default sort field to 'tr.name'.
